# Sirach Chapter 50 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 50 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**50:1** Simon son of Onias the priest, who in his life restored the house of God and in his days fortified the temple.

**50:2** He laid the foundation for the high double walls, the high retaining walls of the temple court.

**50:3** In his days a reservoir was hewn out — a water cistern broad as the sea.

**50:4** He considered how to protect his people from raiders and fortified his city against the enemy.

**50:5** How glorious he was when the people surrounded him as he came out from behind the veil of the sanctuary!

**50:6** Like the morning star among the clouds, like the full moon at the festival season,

**50:7** like the sun blazing on the temple of the Most High, like a rainbow gleaming in clouds of glory,

**50:8** like a rose in bloom at the season of first fruits, like a lily beside a pool of water, like a sprig of frankincense in summer heat,

**50:9** like fire and incense burning in the censer, like a vessel of beaten gold set with precious stones of every kind,

**50:10** like an olive tree laden with fruit, and like a cypress towering above the clouds —

**50:11** when he vested himself in glorious robes and clothed himself in the fullness of splendor, as he mounted the steps of the holy altar, he filled the court of the sanctuary with glory.

**50:12** When he received the portions from the hands of the priests, while he himself stood by the altar hearth, with his brothers forming a wreath around him, he was like a young cedar of Lebanon in the midst of a ring of palm trees.

**50:13** And all the sons of Aaron in their splendor, with the Lord's fire offerings in their hands, before the whole congregation of Israel.

**50:14** Until he had completed the service of the altar and had arranged the offering of the Almighty Most High,

**50:15** he stretched his hand to the cup of libation and poured out wine from the blood of the grape; he poured it at the base of the altar, a sweet aroma to the Most High, the King of all.

**50:16** Then the sons of Aaron shouted and blew on their metal trumpets and sounded a mighty fanfare to be remembered before the Most High.

**50:17** Then all the people together hurried forward and fell on their faces to the ground, to worship before the Most High, before the Holy One of Israel.

**50:18** The sound of singing rose up, and sweet melody rang out over the great multitude.

**50:19** All the people of the land prayed and petitioned before the merciful Lord until the worship of the Lord was accomplished and his service was completed.

**50:20** Then he came down and lifted up his hands over the whole congregation of Israel; the blessing of the Lord was upon his lips, and he glorified himself in the name of the Lord.

**50:21** And they bowed down a second time to receive the blessing from the Most High.

**50:22** And now bless the God of all, who does great things in every way, who exalts our days from the womb and deals with us according to his mercy.

**50:23** May he grant us joy of heart, and may there be peace in our days in Israel, as in days of old.

**50:24** May his mercy remain with us always, and may he redeem us in our days!

**50:25** My soul detests two nations, and a third is not even a people:

**50:26** those who live in Seir, and the Philistines, and the foolish people who dwell in Shechem.

**50:27** Instruction in understanding and knowledge I have written in this book — I, Jesus son of Sirach of Jerusalem — who poured out wisdom like rain.

**50:28** Blessed is he who meditates on these things; the one who takes them to heart will become wise.

**50:29** For if he puts them into practice, he will be equal to anything; for the light of the Lord is his path.
